newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent up as NYMEX strengthens on stock data.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent up as NYMEX strengthens on stock data.

text.p: Brent crude futures were firmer on Friday, supported by a firmer tone on NYMEX in the wake of stock data.
February Brent was last traded at $23.50 per barrel, up 11 cents from the London settlement on Tuesday -- London's last trading day. Volume was 235 lots.

Brokers said the strong draw on crude stocks in the United States, both reflected in API and EIA data, had supported the market, although they cautioned a true reaction might not be factored in until the market is running at full steam after the New Year.
NYMEX February crude last traded on ACCESS at $25.11 per barrel, up 19 cents from New York overnight.
Heating oil, supported by a draw in distillate stocks in the data, was last traded at 71.00 cents per gallon, regaining 0.94 of New York's 1.34 loss.
The API reported a 5.16 million barrel draw in crude and the EIA showed a 6.1 million drop in stocks.
API said distillates fell 1.89 million barrels and the EIA recorded a fall of 1.5 million.
